fluff.overview: Most Clan infantry are solahma warriors at the end of their careers or who have failed their Trials, assigned to duties the warrior caste considers beneath notice. Mechanized Wheeled Points use wheeled armored vehicles that balance speed and protection better than hovercraft or motorcycles. Effective on developed road networks and open terrain, they sacrifice the all-terrain capability of tracked vehicles for better sustained speed on firm ground. Support elements carry man-portable short-range missile launchers firing the same warheads used by BattleMechs and combat vehicles, giving the Point a potent anti-armor punch at close range.
